summary: Skyworks Solutions filed an 8-K announcing an extension of its exchange offers for Qorvo's 4.375% Senior Notes due 2029 and 3.375% Senior Notes due 2031. The offers, under an S-4 registration statement effective May 29, 2026, were extended from September 1 to September 11, 2026. Skyworks expresses hope the related Mergers close within the calendar year but provides no assurances. All other terms remain unchanged. The extension reflects ongoing regulatory or condition satisfaction; watch for closing announcements and any further extensions.
